description: This file defines the class 'TemplateDate' which extends 'TemplateRange' and represents a date input field within the SuiteCRM platform. It includes properties for type, length, and date strings, as well as methods for default database value, template rendering for editing, and field definition.

classes.name: TemplateDate
classes.description: Represents a date type dynamic field in SuiteCRM, providing configuration and rendering methods for date input fields.

methods.name: get_db_default
methods.description: Returns the default database value for the date field, which is empty string.

methods.name: get_xtpl_edit
methods.description: Prepares and returns an array of variables for rendering the date input field in the edit view, including date format and default value.

methods.name: get_field_def
methods.description: Returns the field definition array, modifying default display if set.
